title: Wire Sketchpad Kit Store End To End
description: Refactor CQRS event sourcing flow so sketchpad dev JSON kit opening initializes the RS-backed kit store end-to-end with three graphs, initial kit snapshot, initial checkpoint, and initial unsaved change on the kit. Renaming must start a semantic change and save it when complete. State must come only from semio/rs.
summary: Wired dev JSON bundle persistence through semio/rs: added GraphQL serialize/hydrate fields, made semio/js persist the RS bundle instead of '{}', bootstrapped empty JSON kits as 'the kit' with seed checkpoint and open unsaved change, and made the React registry apply/persist the initial RS snapshot on open. Verified Rust schema/bundle tests, JS embedded tests/build, React build, and Sketchpad build.
